messages:
lina.partnerships: Heads-up: small-blocker for the marketplace listing launch tomorrow — privacy & telemetry need one more review. We must be explicit about what telemetry is collected and provide an opt-out for deployments.

omar.security: I can review. Short summary: anonymized usage metrics (token counts, feature flags usage), error traces (no PII), and health pings. Need to document retention (30 days by default) and offer an opt-out toggle for private deployments.

tess.pm: We also need to confirm the marketplace UI description mentions telemetry and a link to docs. Can marketing add a short line?

diego.eng: From the packaging side: installer sends heartbeat to telemetry.redwood.ai on 443 and uploads aggregated counters hourly. For private deployments we will ship a flag `--no-telemetry` to disable outbound. Docs will show how to configure a local telemetry sink.

harper.ops: Ops note: NAT rules must allow outbound to telemetry.redwood.ai:443 when telemetry is enabled. I'll add this to the ops checklist and the installer troubleshooting section.

marketplace-bot: Credential scan: all required artifacts present. Privacy review queued: /internal/reviews/privacy/1779759999.

lina.partnerships: Great. @omar.security please approve wording; @tess.pm can you add a one-line disclosure for the UI and a link to the privacy doc? After approvals I'll greenlight staging publish.

omar.security: Approved with one edit: change "anonymized" to "aggregated and pseudonymized" in the doc to be clearer.

tess.pm: Adding the UI copy now: "Redwood collects aggregated usage metrics to improve reliability and product quality. You can disable telemetry during installation or in product settings. See [privacy docs]." Adding to the PR.

diego.eng: Pushed PR with `--no-telemetry` flag and docs for Workload Identity + private sink. Reviewer note: verify no plaintext keys are emitted in logs.

harper.ops: I'll validate the staging publish once PR merges and confirm NAT guidance in the runbook.

lina.partnerships: Thanks team — publishing to staging after merges. Will post the staging listing link here. :rocket:
